# Omi AI

> > Omi AI is a voice-to-notes transcription platform combining wearable hardware (Omi Glass Dev Kit) with AI-powered note-taking, summarization, and memory recall for individuals and enterprises.

Omi AI provides an open-source smart glasses developer kit and AI-powered note-taking application designed to capture and process conversations in real-time. The platform serves multiple industries including sales, healthcare, and field services with features like automatic transcription, task automation, and CRM integration.

## Key Topics

- Voice transcription
- Omi Glass Dev Kit
- AI note-taking
- Wearable technology
- Open-source hardware
- Conversation recording
- AI memory recall
- Smart glasses
- Lifelogging
- Enterprise security
- HIPAA compliance
- CRM integration
- Bluetooth 5.1
- AES-256-GCM encryption
- App marketplace

## Core Products

- [Omi AI - Note Taking App](https://omi.me/pages/product): Main product featuring conversation recording, transcription, AI summarization, and automatic task extraction
- [Omi Glass Dev Kit](https://www.omi.me/products/omi-glass-dev-kit): Open-source smart glasses with always-on camera, audio capture, and developer-friendly hardware specifications
- [Omi Apps Marketplace](https://omi.me/apps): 662+ AI-powered applications for Omi necklace spanning productivity, entertainment, and integration use cases
- [Omi Glass Product Overview](https://omi.me/glass): Smart glasses product page highlighting always-on capture, open-source architecture, and ecosystem integrations

## Industry Solutions

- [Omi for Sales Teams](https://omi.me/sales): Call recording, summarization, and CRM integration to help sales teams close 30% more deals with AI coaching
- [Omi for Healthcare](https://omi.me/healthcare): HIPAA-compliant AI medical scribe with EMR integration for automated clinical documentation
- [Omi for Technicians](https://omi.me/technicians): Field service solution automating visit documentation and workflow management to save 10+ hours weekly
- [Case Studies](https://www.omi.me/blogs/news/case-studies): Real-world implementations showcasing Omi's impact across sales, healthcare, and student productivity
